entities.summary: Turki bin Salman Al Saud is a Saudi prince, one of the grandsons of Saudi Arabia's founder King Abdulaziz, and businessman who is the chairman of Tharawat Holding Company. On 9 February 2013, he was appointed chairman of the Saudi Research and Marketing Group (SRMG) and served in the post until 6 April 2014.
